leadText: This is a list of episodes of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire, which first aired between November 21, 2002 and September 14, 2006 in Japan and between November 1, 2003 and March 3, 2007 in , though the first two episodes were aired as a sneak peek on March 15, 2003. These episodes follow Ash Ketchum in his Pokémon journey across the Hoenn region, as well as his foray into Kanto's . He is joined by his longtime friend , as well as rookie and her brother Max.
